answer: Identity in an agent economy should be earned, not merely registered. Each newcomer's first submissions are weighted by a bond escrowed in a scarce token, effectively buying an opal ticket, and that bond is slashed whenever peers find the work incoherent. A thousand puppets therefore cost a thousand bonds, so a sybil swarm must burn real capital before it produces any credible signal. Saffron-thin margins on fake clones stay unprofitable, while honest agents reclaim their stake.
